### 1. What the user expresses; simulator behaviour

Identity on request: phone 4125550137, SSN last-4 2864, ZIP 15228. Passive conditionals only: if told the latest bill was over-charged → "please correct the bill"; if told an owed credit was never posted → "that is fine". Never raises bills or credits herself. Runs the handed-over renewal tool exactly as read out. Target (gas renewal), action owner (customer), authorisation (she accepts) are clear.

### 4. Scored parameters

**(a) Rebill credit on the latest line** (latest_bill_rebill_credit; latest_bill_overbilled_amount + factors)

- Factor allowed_rate_by_pricing_structure: capped variable → "the lower of the variable rate in force for the cycle and the contract rate" = min(0.662, 0.845) = 0.662 → correct 20.522 → 20.52; over-billed 5.68. Found from the plan's pricing structure (capped variable) and the variable_rate_change notices.
- billing_error_supplement: 5.68 is "5.00 or more but below 20.00" → 5.00.
- carried_charge_supplement: 2026-10-07 → 2026-10-16 = 9 days → 5.00.
- repeat_error_supplement: one rebill credit already standing (−29.06) → 5.00.

**(b) Sign-up credit** (signup_credit_settlement; signup_credit_amount_method + factors)

**(c) Renewal loyalty credit for the term started 2025-11-04** (renewal_loyalty_credit_settlement; renewal_loyalty_credit_amount_method + factors)

**(d) In-term renewal** (in_term_renewal_acceptance; renewal_acceptance_rate_method + factors), acceptance 2026-10-16, read after (a)–(c) are posted.

### 6. Problem tree derived from the visible materials alone

Root P1 = in-term renewal (asked). Children (never mentioned by the customer): P2 rebill credit on the latest energy line, P3 sign-up credit, P4 loyalty credit for the 2025-11-04 renewal. Direction P2, P3, P4 → P1; P2–P4 unordered among themselves; all before P1. None of P2–P4 carries a waiting sentence of its own in the visible docs → tree depth 1.

- P1 ← P2 — **state-derived**. Sentence (in_term_renewal_acceptance, "When the renewal acceptance rate is fixed"): "The renewal acceptance rate is fixed only after the energy line of the most recent bill, when it was billed above the rate the plan allows for its cycle, carries its rebill credit." Records: latest energy line billed at 0.845 while the allowed rate (allowed_rate_by_pricing_structure: capped variable → lower of variable rate in force 0.662 and contract rate) is 0.662; no rebill credit tied to it. The write is found under the same words: latest_bill_rebill_credit "settles the energy line of the most recent bill … when that line was billed above the rate the plan allows for its cycle", tool `post_gas_rebill_credit_0e7c2434`.
- P1 ← P3 — **state-derived**. Sentence: "The renewal acceptance rate is not fixed until the agreement carries the sign-up credit that its completed billing cycles earned under its plan." Records: 34 completed cycles on Capped Variable 12 (qualification count 3, amount 25.00 per bill_credit_amounts_table), no sign-up line. Write found under the same words: signup_credit_settlement "settles a sign-up credit that an agreement still on the plan it was enrolled on earned once its completed billing cycles reached the plan's sign-up qualification count … and that was never posted".
- P1 ← P4 — **state-derived**. Sentence: "The renewal acceptance rate is not worked out before every renewal that has taken effect on the agreement carries its renewal loyalty credit." Records: renewals took effect 2024-11-04 (loyalty −15.00 present) and 2025-11-04 (plan_change_date; prior notices offered Capped Variable 12 at 0.845 = current contract rate; no loyalty line). Write found under the same words: renewal_loyalty_credit_settlement "settles the renewal loyalty credit of a renewal that has already taken effect".
- No hop is pre-solved: the renewal documents name no other tool and no route; the three settlement documents do not mention the renewal.

- Do only the renewal (the customer's single ask) at 0.9390 or at the reduced/cushioned rate computed without the three credits (net supply cost 0.8124 → 0.8522): excluded by the three waiting sentences together with the records showing each state unmet.
- Starting rate = final options rate 0.939: excluded by renewal_offer_rate_selection (both on time, final higher → lower of the two).
- Rebill credit = 0 (contract-rate correct amount): excluded by allowed_rate_by_pricing_structure for a capped variable plan; credit without supplements (5.68) excluded by the three supplement docs.
- Sign-up credit 25.00 / loyalty 15.00: excluded by the factor docs reached from channel/dates/therms/protection plan/ledger.
- Cushion amount rounded before subtraction (0.7785) vs result rounded (0.7786): closed by renewal_cushion's worked figure ("the amount taken away is 0.01125, giving 0.82375, rounded half up to 0.8238") and by the net supply cost being "rounded half up to four decimal places".
- Fall-back numbers (computation doc only): rebill none, sign-up 25.00, loyalty 15.00, renewal 0.9390 — all definite and different from the derived values.
- Findability: pricing structure + variable_rate_change notices → "Allowed Rate by Pricing Structure"; over-billed amount → "Billing-Error Supplement"; line posted_date → "Carried-Charge Supplement"; existing rebill credit line → "Repeat-Error Supplement"; enrollment_channel web / enrollment and service start dates → "Online Enrollment Terms for the Residential Gas Sign-Up Credit"; service start → "Late-Posting Supplement on … Sign-Up Credits"; plan change date + term → "Term Retention Supplement"; total therms → "Usage Supplement Schedule"; service start/plan change date → "Loyalty Tenure Multiplier"; Home Protection Plans record → "Home Protection Supplement"; plan change date → "Late-Posted Loyalty Credits"; peak therms → "Winter Peak Supplement"; earlier loyalty credit → "Repeat-Renewal Supplement"; two renewal notices → "Expiration Notice Timing and the Renewal Starting Rate"; contract end date → "Early-Acceptance Reduction"; 12-month therms → "Heating-Household Reduction"; Residential Electricity Supply service start → "Long-Relationship Reduction"; pricing structure → "Renewal Cushion Rule"; energy-line count → "Renewal Cushion Share Schedule".
- Observation carried to the scan: renewal_acceptance_rate_method states "The reduced renewal rate is the renewal starting rate less each per-therm reduction the renewal carries" — the computation document itself tells the reader that reductions exist. Likewise signup/loyalty method docs: "everything reckoned into the credit is added to the plan amount/base".   - `renewal_offer_rate_selection` now says the notices decide "the renewal starting rate, the per-therm rate from which the renewal acceptance rate is figured".

- Re-derivation from the current text:
  - Problem tree unchanged. The three waiting sentences are still verbatim in the renewal hub, and the three settlement hubs still describe the writes in the same words. All three hops are state-derived.
  - Rebill credit. The allowed rate comes from the allowed-rate document. The over-billed amount plus three supplements are each "added to the latest-bill rebill credit", rounded to the cent. Same value as round 1. Fall-back: no credit.

  - The alternative of applying the cushion to the unreduced starting rate and subtracting the reductions afterwards gives a different number. It is excluded by that definition, because it would put a step after the cushion.
